items.q: Who does the seller think he’s talking to?
items.a: To you. The message goes out in your name, from your account. When he replies, you’re the one who calls.

items.q: I don’t speak German, Dutch or Italian. Is that a problem?
items.a: No. The first message goes out in the seller’s own language. After that most sellers are happy with a call, simple English, or a translator.

items.q: Do I need to be good with computers?
items.a: No. We set everything up. You just use WhatsApp, like you already do.

items.q: Can I check messages before they go out?
items.a: Yes. Fully automatic, or one tap on WhatsApp to approve each car. Your choice, any time.

items.q: Do you negotiate or buy for me?
items.a: No. The bot gets you the first conversation. Price, payment, papers and transport stay with you.

items.q: Which cars can it look for?
items.a: Any make and model you buy, with your years, kilometres and budget. Damaged cars too, if that’s your business.

items.q: Why €250 a month? Alerts cost €30.
items.a: An alert tells you about a car. It doesn’t write to the seller, doesn’t write in the seller’s language and doesn’t work at 7 a.m. while you sleep. Your fee pays for the AI, the sender, the upkeep and a real person. One extra car a month pays it back many times.

items.q: Is it really AI?
items.a: Yes. A few AI helpers work in the background: one reads the listings, one checks the car against your rules, one writes the message in the seller’s language. The automation sends it. We watch over all of it.

items.q: Will sellers think it’s spam?
items.a: No. One polite, personal message per car, in proper German, never the same text twice. It reads like a serious buyer, because behind it there is one: you.

items.q: Is it legal and safe?
items.a: It’s built to follow the marketplace rules and EU data protection. Messages are honest and in your real name, and the bot stops if a platform asks for a check. If anything goes wrong, we fix it at our cost. More in the safety section above.

items.q: What if something breaks, or I get no messages?
items.a: Write to us on WhatsApp. We answer and start the fix within 24 hours, and it’s on us.

items.q: How fast is the setup, and where does it run?
items.a: 24 to 48 hours after our call. On your computer, in our cloud or on our own servers, whichever we pick together. You never touch the tech.

items.q: What happens in the free test?
items.a: You send up to 3 mobile.de searches. We run them on our side and message sellers from our own account. If a seller answers, you get a WhatsApp from us and you decide if you take over. No card, no strings.

items.q: Do you take a cut of my deals?
items.a: Never. The price is fixed. Every euro of profit stays with you.

items.q: Can I cancel? Can I use Telegram?
items.a: Monthly plan: cancel any month. Yearly plan: you’ve paid for 12 months, with setup free. We start with WhatsApp and can set up Telegram too.

items.q: Is this an affiliate program?
items.a: Yes, it works like one: your own tracking link, a discount code and commissions on every dealership you bring. We call you a partner because you get real support and a long-term relationship, not just a link.

items.q: Do I need technical knowledge?
items.a: None. You never set anything up and never fix anything. We do the full setup, run the bot and handle every problem.

items.q: Who can I bring?
items.a: Car dealers and importers who buy used cars in Europe, from any country in the Balkans or Europe. They can talk to you in their own language.

items.q: How long do I earn from one dealership?
items.a: €150 at signup, then €50 each month the dealership pays, up to 12 months, plus a €50 bonus when they’re still with us at month 6. That’s up to €800.

items.q: What if the dealership cancels?
items.a: The monthly commission stops when they stop paying. That’s why a friendly check-in from you helps: happy dealers stay.

items.q: Am I responsible if something goes wrong?
items.a: No. Setup, fixes, support and every technical question are ours. If a dealer has a problem, you pass it to us.

items.q: How do I get paid?
items.a: Your €150 setup share is paid within 7 days after we receive the dealership’s payment. Your €50 monthly commissions are paid on the 1st of the next month, as one total for the previous month. The €50 loyalty bonus is paid with the next monthly payout after the dealership reaches month 6. If your dealership takes the yearly plan, you get a flat €800 within 7 days after we receive their payment.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {{LEGAL_ENTITY}} (“Car Bot”, “we”) collects on getcarbot.co, why we collect it and what rights you have.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Car Bot is run by {{LEGAL_ENTITY}}, Skopje, North Macedonia.
For anything about your data, write to {{DPO_EMAIL}}.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Free test and plan requests: your name, surname, email, WhatsApp number, the mobile.de search links you send us, the plan you choose, a partner or discount code if you have one, your language and the time of the request.
Partner applications: your name, surname, email, WhatsApp number, country and how you plan to find dealers.
Partner referral: if you arrive through a partner link and accept cookies, we store the partner’s code (for example “ABC”) in a cookie for 90 days so the right partner is credited.
Technical data: your IP address is used briefly to stop abuse of our forms (rate limiting). Our analytics are cookieless and do not identify you.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To run your free test: we run your searches and contact sellers on your behalf.
To contact you on WhatsApp and by email about your test, your plan, your setup call and payment.
To run the partner program: to welcome partners, credit them for the dealerships they bring and pay commissions.
Legal basis: your consent (the box you tick on the form), steps before a contract you ask for, and our legitimate interest in keeping the site safe. You can withdraw consent at any time.

sections.title: Who processes it for us
body: Resend (email delivery and contact lists), Vercel (hosting and cookieless analytics) and, if enabled, Upstash (rate limiting). They process data only on our instructions.
Some of these providers are outside North Macedonia and the EU. Where that is the case, transfers rely on standard contractual clauses or an equivalent safeguard.
We never sell your data and never share it for advertising.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Free test requests that do not become clients: up to 12 months after the last contact.
Client and partner data: for as long as the relationship lasts, then as long as accounting law requires.
The partner referral cookie: 90 days.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct it or delete it, object to its use, or ask us to stop. Write to {{DPO_EMAIL}} and we answer within 30 days.
You can also complain to the Personal Data Protection Agency of North Macedonia (or the authority in your EU country).

sections.title: Contact

terms.intro: These terms apply to getcarbot.co and to the Car Bot service offered by {{LEGAL_ENTITY}}.

sections.title: The service
body: Car Bot is a managed service. We set up and run a bot that watches car marketplaces for the cars you choose and sends the first message to the seller. When a seller replies, we notify you on WhatsApp and you take over.
We do not negotiate, buy, pay for or transport cars for you. Price, payment, papers and transport stay with you.

sections.title: Free test
body: The free test covers up to 3 mobile.de search links. It is free and needs no card. For the test we contact sellers from our own account, in our own words, on your behalf.
We may decline or stop a test at any time, for example if a search breaks a marketplace’s rules.

sections.title: Plans and payment
body: Monthly plan: €500 setup, then €250 a month. You can cancel any month; the month already paid is not refunded.
Yearly plan: €3,000 a year, setup included.
Prices are in euros. We send a payment link (card), bank details or an invoice.

sections.title: Fair use and marketplace rules
body: The bot is built to follow each marketplace’s rules and EU data protection law. It stops when a platform asks for a check or a verification.
You agree to use the service honestly, in your real name, and only to buy cars. We may pause the bot if it is used for spam or anything unlawful.

sections.title: Our responsibility
body: We do our best to keep the bot running. Marketplaces change their sites, so we cannot promise that every listing is found or every message is delivered. If something goes wrong, write to us: we answer and start fixing within 24 hours, at our cost.
We are not liable for the deals you make or do not make. Our total liability is limited to the fees you paid in the last 12 months, unless the law says otherwise.

sections.title: Partner program
body: Partner commissions, payouts and rules are described in the partner welcome package. Partners must be honest with dealers and must not promise results or invent earnings claims.

body: These terms are governed by the law of North Macedonia. Courts in Skopje have jurisdiction, unless consumer law gives you another option.

sections.title: Functional (only after you accept)
body: cb_ref: remembers which partner sent you here (the partner’s code and the date of your first click), so the right partner is credited if you sign up. 90 days. A copy is kept in your browser’s local storage.
If you do not accept, the partner code is kept only for your current browser tab session and is sent with a form only if you submit one.

sections.title: Analytics
body: We use Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights. They are cookieless and do not track you across sites. No advertising or third-party trackers.

sections.title: Change your choice
body: Use the button below or “Cookie settings” in the footer at any time. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings.
